name: EM Carry-to-Vol Rank: BRL, MXN, ZAR, COP
description: Monthly carry-to-vol ranking of BRL, MXN, ZAR, COP vs USD. Carry = local 3M interbank rate minus Fed Funds (annualized %). Vol = 21-day annualized realized volatility of daily FX log returns. Carry-to-vol = carry/vol. Rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, Rank 4 = highest. Pooled rank-bucket analysis: all 4 currencies' monthly observations pooled into rank-1 through rank-4 series. Shows avg next-month EM/USD return by rank (bar chart), N/median/hit rate/mean per rank (summary table), and carry-to-vol over time for all 4 currencies (line chart). Last 10 years.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANK: BRL, MXN, ZAR, COP
# =============================================================================
# Carry = local 3M interbank rate - Fed Funds (annualized %)
# Vol   = 21-day annualized realized vol of daily FX log returns
# Carry-to-vol = carry / vol (dimensionally consistent: both annualized)
# Rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, Rank 4 = highest
# FX convention: USDBRL/USDMXN/USDZAR/USDCOP → invert for EM appreciation
# Monthly timing: rank at EOM, measure next full month EM/USD return
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# FX DATA (USD/EM pairs — invert for EM/USD return)
# =============================================================================

brl_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
mxn_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDMXN')()
zar_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDZAR')()
cop_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDCOP')()

brl_close = brl_fx.c
mxn_close = mxn_fx.c
zar_close = zar_fx.c
cop_close = cop_fx.c

# =============================================================================
# LOCAL 3M INTERBANK RATES (monthly FRED, ffilled to daily)
# Brazil: INTDSRBRM193N (discount rate, best available proxy)
# Mexico: IR3TIB01MXM156N (3M interbank)
# South Africa: IR3TIB01ZAM156N (3M interbank)
# Colombia: COLIR3TIB01STM (3M interbank)
# Fed Funds: DFF (daily effective rate)
# =============================================================================

rate_brl_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='INTDSRBRM193N')()
rate_mxn_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
rate_zar_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
rate_cop_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='COLIR3TIB01STM')()
rate_usd_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()

rate_brl = ffill(rate_brl_raw.result)
rate_mxn = ffill(rate_mxn_raw.result)
rate_zar = ffill(rate_zar_raw.result)
rate_cop = ffill(rate_cop_raw.result)
rate_usd = ffill(rate_usd_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY = LOCAL RATE - FED FUNDS (annualized %, both already annualized)
# =============================================================================

carry_brl = rate_brl - rate_usd
carry_mxn = rate_mxn - rate_usd
carry_zar = rate_zar - rate_usd
carry_cop = rate_cop - rate_usd

# =============================================================================
# 21-DAY ANNUALIZED REALIZED VOL (log returns, annualized via sqrt(252))
# volatility() outputs annualized decimal fraction (e.g., 0.20 = 20% ann vol)
# Multiply by 100 to convert to % to match carry units (%)
# =============================================================================

vol_brl = volatility(period=21)(brl_close) * 100.0
vol_mxn = volatility(period=21)(mxn_close) * 100.0
vol_zar = volatility(period=21)(zar_close) * 100.0
vol_cop = volatility(period=21)(cop_close) * 100.0

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL (carry in %, vol in % → dimensionless ratio)
# Guard against near-zero vol to avoid division artifacts
# =============================================================================

ctv_brl = where(is_valid(vol_brl) and vol_brl > 0.1, carry_brl / vol_brl)
ctv_mxn = where(is_valid(vol_mxn) and vol_mxn > 0.1, carry_mxn / vol_mxn)
ctv_zar = where(is_valid(vol_zar) and vol_zar > 0.1, carry_zar / vol_zar)
ctv_cop = where(is_valid(vol_cop) and vol_cop > 0.1, carry_cop / vol_cop)

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY DOWNSAMPLING (EOM snapshot for ranking)
# =============================================================================

ctv_brl_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_brl)
ctv_mxn_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_mxn)
ctv_zar_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_zar)
ctv_cop_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ctv_cop)

# =============================================================================
# MANUAL CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK (ascending: rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol)
# rank_X = 1 + count of currencies with strictly lower ctv
# Ties broken arbitrarily (rare in practice)
# =============================================================================

rank_brl = 1 + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_mxn_m) and ctv_mxn_m < ctv_brl_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_zar_m) and ctv_zar_m < ctv_brl_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_cop_m) and ctv_cop_m < ctv_brl_m) else 0)
rank_mxn = 1 + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_brl_m) and ctv_brl_m < ctv_mxn_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_zar_m) and ctv_zar_m < ctv_mxn_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_cop_m) and ctv_cop_m < ctv_mxn_m) else 0)
rank_zar = 1 + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_brl_m) and ctv_brl_m < ctv_zar_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_mxn_m) and ctv_mxn_m < ctv_zar_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_cop_m) and ctv_cop_m < ctv_zar_m) else 0)
rank_cop = 1 + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_brl_m) and ctv_brl_m < ctv_cop_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_mxn_m) and ctv_mxn_m < ctv_cop_m) else 0) + (1 if (is_valid(ctv_zar_m) and ctv_zar_m < ctv_cop_m) else 0)

# =============================================================================
# NEXT-MONTH EM/USD RETURN (invert USD/EM: EM appreciation = positive)
# forward_returns(period=1) on monthly bars = next month's return
# EM/USD return = -(USD/EM return) = -(close_next - close_now) / close_now
# Equivalently: (close_now - close_next) / close_now
# Use forward_returns on inverted price: 1/close
# =============================================================================

brl_em = 1.0 / brl_close
mxn_em = 1.0 / mxn_close
zar_em = 1.0 / zar_close
cop_em = 1.0 / cop_close

brl_em_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(brl_em)
mxn_em_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(mxn_em)
zar_em_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(zar_em)
cop_em_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(cop_em)

fwd_brl = forward_returns(period=1)(brl_em_m)
fwd_mxn = forward_returns(period=1)(mxn_em_m)
fwd_zar = forward_returns(period=1)(zar_em_m)
fwd_cop = forward_returns(period=1)(cop_em_m)

# =============================================================================
# POOL OBSERVATIONS INTO RANK BUCKETS (coalesce: exactly one non-NaN per month)
# rank_X == N is True only for the currency ranked N that month
# =============================================================================

pool_r1 = coalesce(where(rank_brl == 1, fwd_brl), where(rank_mxn == 1, fwd_mxn), where(rank_zar == 1, fwd_zar), where(rank_cop == 1, fwd_cop))
pool_r2 = coalesce(where(rank_brl == 2, fwd_brl), where(rank_mxn == 2, fwd_mxn), where(rank_zar == 2, fwd_zar), where(rank_cop == 2, fwd_cop))
pool_r3 = coalesce(where(rank_brl == 3, fwd_brl), where(rank_mxn == 3, fwd_mxn), where(rank_zar == 3, fwd_zar), where(rank_cop == 3, fwd_cop))
pool_r4 = coalesce(where(rank_brl == 4, fwd_brl), where(rank_mxn == 4, fwd_mxn), where(rank_zar == 4, fwd_zar), where(rank_cop == 4, fwd_cop))

# =============================================================================
# HIT RATE (1 if EM appreciated, 0 otherwise — for Mean = hit rate)
# =============================================================================

hit_r1 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r1) and pool_r1 > 0) else 0.0
hit_r2 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r2) and pool_r2 > 0) else 0.0
hit_r3 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r3) and pool_r3 > 0) else 0.0
hit_r4 = 1.0 if (is_valid(pool_r4) and pool_r4 > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY TIMESTAMP (for carry-to-vol line chart x-axis)
# =============================================================================

bar_ts = index()
bar_ts_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(bar_ts)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Avg next-month EM/USD return by carry-to-vol rank (pooled)
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Higher Carry-to-Vol Rank → Better Next-Month EM Returns?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Next-Month EM/USD Return',
    x_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Rank (1=Lowest, 4=Highest)',
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 1', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rank 1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 2', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rank 2'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 3', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rank 3'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 4', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rank 4')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(pool_r1, pool_r2, pool_r3, pool_r4))

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Carry-to-vol over time for all 4 currencies
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Over Time: Which EM Currency Offers Best Compensation?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol (Carry % / Ann. Vol %)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BRL', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MXN', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZAR', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='COP', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=bar_ts_m, y_values=(ctv_brl_m, ctv_mxn_m, ctv_zar_m, ctv_cop_m))

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: N / Median / Hit Rate / Mean per rank bucket (pooled, all 4 currencies)
# Standard mode: 4 ranks × 4 stats = 16 cells
# =============================================================================

# Count (N): use where() to isolate each rank's observations, then Count agg
# Median: use Median agg on pooled return series
# Hit rate: Mean of 1/0 hit series
# Mean: Mean of pooled return series

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Pooled Rank-Bucket Stats: Next-Month EM/USD Return (All 4 Currencies)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Rank 1 (Lowest C/V)', 'Rank 2', 'Rank 3', 'Rank 4 (Highest C/V)'],
        col_headers=['N (Months)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Mean Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol Rank',
    order=0
)(pool_r1, pool_r1, hit_r1, pool_r1,
  pool_r2, pool_r2, hit_r2, pool_r2,
  pool_r3, pool_r3, hit_r3, pool_r3,
  pool_r4, pool_r4, hit_r4, pool_r4)
